scope: forward bracket target lookup diagnostic, no guest execution or authority of host closure
limitations: Diagnostic terminator zero does not prove source length or physical stream closure
Input is required to be a completely preflighted normalized suffix
Forward matching for opening bracket only, not backward program counter dispatch
Relative offset represented as checked u16 and nesting as checked u8 in this bounded component
No output certificate for source offset errors, guest fuel, tape traps, nested self-hosting or Android
